i.title: Tip

div.div:
What is a Campaign Template? A template is a reusable blueprint that pre-fills the "New Campaign" wizard in one click — so you never have to enter the same channel, scoring rules, or playbook steps twice.
See the Guide tab for step-by-step instructions.

field.name: channel
field.help: The lead source channel this template is designed for. The wizard will pre-select this channel in Step 1 (Campaign). • Web Form — leads come from a website contact form • Paid Ads — Facebook/Google Ads campaigns • Email — outbound cold email sequences • API / Webhook — programmatic lead creation • Other — anything else

field.name: assign_min_score
field.help: The minimum qualification score a lead must reach before it is automatically assigned to a salesperson or team. Example: set 50 if you only want to follow up leads that answered at least 2–3 profiling questions correctly. The wizard pre-fills this value in Step 3 (Assignment).

field.name: playbook_name
field.help: Suggested name for the playbook that will be created when the wizard runs. You can rename it in the wizard. Example: 'Hospital Onboarding Q1 2026'

field.name: default_email_template_id
field.help: Optional email template to pre-fill in the campaign wizard. If selected in the wizard, this email is sent once to each newly created lead.

field.name: lead_name_prefix
field.help: When contacts are bulk-converted to leads, this text becomes the lead subject. The contact's name is appended automatically. Example: 'New enquiry — Dr. Sarah Jones'

field.name: active
field.help: Inactive templates are hidden from the wizard's template picker but their data is preserved. Deactivate templates you no longer use instead of deleting them.

field.name: sequence
field.help: Lower numbers appear first in the template list and in the wizard's template picker. Use multiples of 10 so you can insert new templates between existing ones later.

field.name: description
field.placeholder: Describe when to use this template — e.g. 'Use for inbound hospital leads coming via the website contact form. Requires at least email + phone to qualify.'
field.help: Shown to the user in the wizard's template picker so they can choose the right blueprint without opening the record. Be specific: mention the industry, channel, and minimum lead quality you expect.

page.name: scoring
page.div: Tip — Score rules Add one row per data point you want to reward. Leave Lead field blank to create a base rule that gives every lead a starting score (useful as a floor). The wizard copies these rules to a new scoring engine in Step 2.

field.name: score_line_ids
field.help: Each row becomes a qualification rule. Points are positive (reward) or negative (penalty). The total score decides whether the lead is assigned.

field.name: name
field.help: Short label — shown in reports and on the lead timeline.

field.name: lead_field
field.help: The CRM field that must be filled for this rule to score. Leave blank → rule applies to every lead (base score).

field.name: score_delta
field.help: Points added (positive) or deducted (negative). Typical range: 5–30 per rule. Base score: 10–20.

page.name: steps
page.div: Tip — Playbook steps Define the follow-up sequence a salesperson should execute after a lead is qualified. Steps run in order; each can schedule an activity (call, meeting, to-do) or send an email template automatically. The wizard copies these steps to a new playbook in Step 4.

field.name: step_line_ids
field.help: Each row is one follow-up action in the sequence. Drag the handle to re-order steps.

field.name: name
field.help: Visible to the salesperson in their activity list. Be action-oriented: 'Call to confirm interest', 'Send proposal'.

field.name: step_type
field.help: Create activity → schedules a manual task for the salesperson. Send email → fires an automated email via a mail template.

field.name: delay_unit
field.help: When to trigger this step relative to the previous one. Immediate → runs right after the previous step completes. Hours / Days → waits the specified amount before triggering.

field.name: delay_amount
field.help: Number of hours or days to wait. Ignored when Delay is Immediate.

field.name: activity_type_id
field.help: The type of activity to schedule (e.g. Phone Call, Email, Meeting). Must match an activity type configured in your Odoo instance.

field.name: activity_summary
field.help: A short note shown on the activity card so the salesperson knows exactly what to do without opening the lead.

field.name: mail_template_id
field.help: The email template to send. Must target the crm.lead model. Create or edit email templates in Technical → Email Templates.

page.name: contacts
page.div: Tip — Contact Group If your campaign targets a known list of contacts (e.g. existing customers, prospects from a trade show), select a source below. When the wizard uses this template, Step 5 (Contacts) will be pre-filled automatically — saving you from picking them one by one every time. Leave it as No contacts for inbound campaigns (website forms, ads) where leads arrive on their own.

group.string: How should the wizard load contacts for this campaign?

field.name: contact_source
field.help: No contacts — inbound / API campaigns; leads are created externally. All active contacts — blast to your entire contact database. By tag — target a specific audience segment (e.g. 'Hospital', 'VIP'). Manual — pick contacts one by one for a highly targeted campaign.

page.div: All active individual contacts in your database will be pre-loaded into the wizard. You can still remove contacts before launching the campaign.

group.string: Select one or more contact tags

field.name: partner_category_ids
field.help: All active contacts that carry ANY of the selected tags will be loaded into the wizard automatically. Tags are managed in Contacts → Configuration → Contact Tags.

div.div: Every active contact tagged with any of the above tags will be pre-loaded in Step 5 of the wizard. You can review and deselect contacts before launching.
No tags selected yet — add at least one tag above so the wizard knows which contacts to load.
Add contacts below. These exact contacts will be pre-loaded every time this template is used in the wizard. Click Add a line to search and pick contacts.

field.name: partner_ids
field.help: Fixed list of contacts always included when this template is used.

page.div: Inbound / API mode. No contacts will be pre-loaded. Leads arrive via web form, API endpoint, CRM import, or are entered manually by the team.

field.name: note
field.placeholder: Internal notes about this template — visible only to managers…
field.help: Free-text internal notes. Not shown to end users. Use this to document: who owns the template, when it was last reviewed, and any special setup instructions.

div.h4: How to fill in a Campaign Template

div.strong: Step 1 — Give the template a name and channel

div.p: The Template name is shown in the wizard's template picker — make it descriptive. Examples: "Hospital Inbound — Web Form", "Cold Email — SME Sector".
Channel tells the wizard which lead source to create. Pick the channel that matches how leads will arrive:

ul.li: Web Form — website contact / enquiry form
Paid Ads — Facebook Lead Ads, Google Ads

div.p: Score rules determine how qualified a lead is. Each rule adds or deducts points when a CRM field is filled.
Set Min. score to assign (in Defaults) to the threshold above which a lead gets routed to sales. A score of 50 means the lead must provide email + phone + company.
Playbook steps are the follow-up actions executed after a lead qualifies. They run in sequence:

ul.li: Create activity — schedules a task (call, meeting, email) for the assigned salesperson.
Send email — fires an automated email via a pre-built Odoo mail template.

div.p: Use Delay to space steps out: "Immediate" → runs right away; "1 Day" → waits 24 hours. A typical sequence: Call (immediate) → Proposal email (3 days) → Follow-up call (7 days).
Only needed for outbound campaigns where you already know who you want to target:

ul.li: No contacts — leave this for inbound campaigns (web form, ads). Leads arrive on their own.
All active contacts — broadcast to your entire contact database.
By tag — target a segment, e.g. all contacts tagged "Hospital" or "VIP Customer".
Manual — hand-pick a small group (e.g. 10 key accounts for a personalised campaign).

div.strong: Using the template in the wizard

ol.li: In Step 1, open the Load from template dropdown and pick this template.
All steps are pre-filled — review and adjust any value.
Click Launch on the Review step. The engine, scoring rules, playbook, and leads are created automatically.
